params.name: alt
params.description: Description for an icon that carries meaning; omit for decoration.

params.name: area
params.description: This element's grid-area — the name of a cell declared in the parent's `areas`.

params.name: aria
params.description: ARIA attributes, e.g. {label: "Close", hidden: true, current: "page", live: "polite", describedBy: "note"} → aria-label="Close", aria-hidden="true", … Booleans become "true"/"false", arrays of ids are space-joined, null removes the attribute.

params.name: background
params.description: Background — any CSS colour or background shorthand.

params.name: block
params.description: Render as a block-level element rather than inline.

params.name: bold
params.description: Shorthand for font-weight bold. Overrides `weight` if both are given.

params.name: border
params.description: A plain CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #0B0B0C", on every element. Object forms a component knows ({width, color}, a design node) keep working where they did.

params.name: borderObj
params.description: Border as {width, color, type?, radius?}. Width carries its unit, e.g. "1px".

params.name: bottom
params.description: CSS bottom, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: breakWord
params.description: Allow long words to wrap mid-word (word-wrap: break-word).

params.name: center
params.description: Centres this element's CHILDREN. `true` for both axes, `"x"` horizontal, `"y"` vertical. Axis-aware: in a flex column `"y"` is justify-content, in a row it is align-items; a grid uses justify-items/align-items. To centre the element itself inside its parent, use `mar: "center"`.

params.name: clipPath
params.description: CSS clip-path, e.g. "inset(0 round 12px)" or "circle(50%)". On img a value that is not CSS is read as SVG path data, as before.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: CSS color-scheme, e.g. "light": the scheme the browser draws this element's native parts in (form controls, the option list of a select) and its descendants'. A page that declares `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">` to keep Chrome's auto dark mode off still gets dark controls for visitors in dark mode; colorScheme "light" on its sections keeps them light.

params.name: columns
params.description: CSS columns (multi-column text), e.g. "2" or "18em 3". On gridOverlay `columns` is its own cell count.

params.name: copy
params.description: Copy this text to the clipboard on click, Enter or Space (`true` copies the element's own text). The element becomes a keyboard-operable button and shows `copied` for 1.5 s, announced politely to screen readers.

params.name: count
params.description: Count the first number in the text up when it scrolls into view: `true`, or {from: 0, to, duration: 1200, decimals, locale}. Only the first number moves; the text ends exactly as written and screen readers get the final figure throughout. Reduced motion shows the final text.

params.name: cssFilter
params.description: CSS filter, verbatim — e.g. "blur(4px) saturate(1.2)". Named cssFilter because `filter` on a wrap means frosted glass, and the `filter` design op is a node.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Machine-readable date/time for a `time` element (text `tag: "time"`, wrap `as: "time"`), written to its datetime attribute, e.g. "2026-06-14" or "2026-06-14T09:00". Ignored on any other tag.

params.name: exact
params.description: Font size as an exact CSS length, e.g. "0.875rem".

params.name: fit
params.description: Scale the font so the text fills the element's width on one line; re-fits on resize and when web fonts load.

params.name: flexDirection
params.description: CSS flex-direction ("row", "column", …). On a wrap it is `flexDir` by its CSS name and also sets display:flex.

params.name: focus
params.description: Styles for keyboard focus (focus-visible, on the element or inside it), when they should differ from `hover`. Same shape as hover.

params.name: fontStretch
params.description: CSS font-stretch — a variable font's width, e.g. "125%" for wide letters (the font must load that width range).

params.name: fontVariantNumeric
params.description: CSS font-variant-numeric, e.g. "tabular-nums" for aligned figures.

params.name: fontVariationSettings
params.description: CSS font-variation-settings — set a variable font's axes directly, e.g. "'wdth' 151, 'GRAD' 50".

params.name: gap
params.description: CSS gap, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: gpos
params.description: Grid placement — {col, row}, written to grid-column and grid-row.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover
params.description: Styles this element takes while its nearest `group: true` ancestor is hovered or holds keyboard focus, e.g. {color: "#b83a0b", transform: "translateX(4px)"}. Same shape as hover.

params.name: height
params.description: CSS height — a length with a unit.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: hover
params.description: Styles applied while the pointer is over the element AND while it (or something inside it) has keyboard focus, e.g. {background: "#111", color: "#fff", animation: "0.2s ease"}. Any CSS property in camelCase; `animation` is the transition timing. The original inline styles come back on leave. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: icon
params.description: An image beside the link text: {url, size: "20px", padding: "10px" (the gap between them), side: "end" (after the text) or "start" (before it, as a flag before a language name), alt: ""}. Decorative by default (empty alt, hidden from screen readers) because the link already has a name — its text, or `aria: {label}` for an icon-only link. Give `alt` only when the icon says something the name does not.

params.name: id
params.description: This element's DOM id. Also what a design node's `target` names, and what `parse` recovers an element by.

params.name: keySet
params.description: Escape hatch — {key, value} written straight to element.style, or an array of them.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of this element's content, e.g. "cs" — so a screen reader switches pronunciation for a quote or a name in another language.

params.name: loop
params.description: Animate the element forever, with no stylesheet: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], duration: ms, easing, direction, delay}. Keyframes are CSS properties in camelCase, e.g. [{backgroundPosition: "0px 0"}, {backgroundPosition: "99px 0"}]. Skipped for prefers-reduced-motion and where the browser has no Web Animations (the prerender).

params.name: mar
params.description: Margin. The same array-of-side-objects form as `pad`: `mar: [{a: 40}]`, keys `a t r b l`, combinable. Additionally `mar: "center"` sets left and right to auto, as does `{a: "auto"}` or `{center: true}`.

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: CSS max-height — a length with a unit.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: CSS max-width — a length with a unit.

params.name: minHeight
params.description: CSS min-height, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: minWidth
params.description: CSS min-width, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: onScroll
params.description: Tie a style to the scroll position: {value: "opacity" | "scale" | "trn", from, to (scrollY px), valMin, valMax} — for "trn", valMin/valMax are {tx, ty}. Under prefers-reduced-motion it does nothing: no scroll listener, and the element keeps its own style.

params.name: pad
params.description: Padding. An array of side objects: `pad: [{a: 40}]`. Keys are `a` all, `t` top, `r` right, `b` bottom, `l` left. Keys combine, so `{tb: 12}` sets top and bottom. A bare number is treated as px; any string is passed through, so `{a: "2rem"}` works.

params.name: pin
params.description: Keep the element stuck to the top of the viewport for this much extra scroll, e.g. "80vh". Also {length: "200vh", media: "(min-width: 900px)"} or an ARRAY of those — the first whose media matches wins, and nothing matching means no pin (a sideways track on desktop only, or only with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`) — position: sticky, followed by an empty aria-hidden spacer of that height. Sticks within its PARENT: it stays stuck until the parent ends, so siblings after it scroll past underneath it — pin the last child of a wrap. An ancestor with overflow other than visible, or a stretching flex row, stops it sticking. Applies under reduced motion too (pinning is not motion).

params.name: preffersId
params.description: Prefer this id when the Designer emits code for the element.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius. A bare number is read as pixels; a string is used verbatim.

params.name: raster
params.description: Attach a WebGL raster pipeline. Array of op nodes; see the Raster section.

params.name: resmar
params.description: Responsive margin — per-breakpoint overrides of `mar`, in the same form.

params.name: respad
params.description: Responsive padding — per-breakpoint overrides of `pad`, in the same form.

params.name: resprop
params.description: Per-breakpoint style overrides — [{breakpoint, ...css}], {min, max, ...css}, {container: {min, max}, ...css}, or {media: "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)", ...css} for any media query (reduced motion, hover, orientation). Precedence: container, then media, then width. `exact` is font size.

params.name: reveal
params.description: Entrance when the element scrolls into view: {y: 24, x: 0, opacity: 0, scale, duration: 700, delay: 0, easing, stagger: ms, by: "word"|"line", once: true, threshold: 0.15}. `stagger` brings the element's CHILDREN in one after another; `by` (text) brings its words or lines in. Ends at the element's own opacity and position. Elements already scrolled past show at once, and so does what was on screen in the prerendered copy when the live page takes over. Nothing is hidden for reduced-motion visitors or where it cannot run (the prerender). On `img`, `reveal` is the image's own mask reveal instead.

params.name: right
params.description: CSS right, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: role
params.description: ARIA role, e.g. "note", "region", "button". Prefer a semantic tag (`as`, `tag`) where one exists.

params.name: scrollSnapAlign
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-align on a child, e.g. "start" or "center".

params.name: scrollSnapType
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-type on the scroll container, e.g. "x mandatory".

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.name: size
params.description: Fluid type scale step (S1…S6) — font size that scales with the viewport. On a text element (h1…h6, p) the element TYPE picks the step and this is ignored; use `tag` to change the heading level without changing the size.
params.deprecated: on this component `size()` set width and height, which collided with the `size` option (fluid type scale). Use `dimensions(w, h)`.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). Uses the element's own `scrub` range when it has one. The real text stays in the page for screen readers, selection and innerText; the slices are the letter's own ::before/::after (with empty alt text), not elements. Nothing is split at prerender or under reduced motion. Do not combine with `reveal` by word or line on the same element.

params.name: spy
params.description: Scroll spy: the in-page links inside this element (href="#id") are marked aria-current="true" and styled while their section is the one in view — the section that crosses the reading line, 30% down the view below `offset` (see spy.line). `true`, or {activeStyle: {…css}, offset: px, line: 0.3}. Default style: underline. Links to <body>/<html>, or to an element that contains the link (e.g. `#top` on <body id="top">), are never treated as sections.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: Tab order: 0 puts the element in the natural order, -1 makes it focusable from script only. Positive values reorder the page and are best avoided.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag to render, independent of `size`/`fluid`: a heading level (h1–h6, p) or a text-level tag — blockquote, figcaption, li, dt, dd, cite, time, small, strong, em, span, q, address, label.

params.name: textWrap
params.description: CSS text-wrap, e.g. "balance" for headings or "pretty" for paragraphs.

params.name: title
params.description: Advisory tooltip (the title attribute). Not applied where `title` is already the element's visible label (dropdown, form fields) — a tooltip repeating the label adds noise.

params.name: transform
params.description: A CSS transform string applied verbatim, or an object handled by reactOnTransform(). Composed with `scale` when both are given.

params.name: transition
params.description: CSS transition, verbatim — also what hover/focus/groupHover changes animate with when they give no `animation` timing.

params.name: type
params.description: The element type, which selects the mapper that builds it -- "h1", "cards", "form", and so on.

params.name: vars
params.description: Custom CSS properties on this element — {"--nod-split": 0.2}. Custom properties inherit, so writing them on a root drives its whole subtree with one declaration; that is how the morph axes reach every generated element without a stylesheet.

params.name: width
params.description: CSS width — a length with a unit, e.g. "100%" or "320px". A bare number is not a CSS length and is ignored.

params.name: fit

params.name: flexDirection
params.description: CSS flex-direction ("row", "column", …). On a wrap it is `flexDir` by its CSS name and also sets display:flex.

params.name: focus

params.name: fontStretch
params.description: CSS font-stretch — a variable font's width, e.g. "125%" for wide letters (the font must load that width range).

params.name: fontVariantNumeric
params.description: CSS font-variant-numeric, e.g. "tabular-nums" for aligned figures.

params.name: fontVariationSettings

params.name: gap

params.name: gpos
params.description: Grid placement — {col, row}, written to grid-column and grid-row.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover

params.name: height
params.description: CSS height — a length with a unit.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: keySet

params.name: lang

params.name: loop

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: CSS max-height — a length with a unit.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: CSS max-width — a length with a unit.

params.name: minHeight
params.description: CSS min-height, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: minWidth
params.description: CSS min-width, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius. A bare number is read as pixels; a string is used verbatim.

params.name: respad
params.description: Responsive padding — per-breakpoint overrides of `pad`, in the same form.

params.name: raster
params.description: Attach a WebGL raster pipeline. Array of op nodes; see the Raster section.

params.name: resmar
params.description: Responsive margin — per-breakpoint overrides of `mar`, in the same form.

params.name: respad
params.description: Responsive padding — per-breakpoint overrides of `pad`, in the same form.

params.name: resprop
params.description: Per-breakpoint style overrides — [{breakpoint, ...css}], {min, max, ...css}, {container: {min, max}, ...css}, or {media: "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)", ...css} for any media query (reduced motion, hover, orientation). Precedence: container, then media, then width. `exact` is font size.

params.name: reveal
params.description: Entrance when the element scrolls into view: {y: 24, x: 0, opacity: 0, scale, duration: 700, delay: 0, easing, stagger: ms, by: "word"|"line", once: true, threshold: 0.15}. `stagger` brings the element's CHILDREN in one after another; `by` (text) brings its words or lines in. Ends at the element's own opacity and position. Elements already scrolled past show at once, and so does what was on screen in the prerendered copy when the live page takes over. Nothing is hidden for reduced-motion visitors or where it cannot run (the prerender). On `img`, `reveal` is the image's own mask reveal instead.

params.name: right
params.description: CSS right, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: role
params.description: ARIA role, e.g. "note", "region", "button". Prefer a semantic tag (`as`, `tag`) where one exists.

params.name: scrollSnapAlign
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-align on a child, e.g. "start" or "center".

params.name: scrollSnapType
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-type on the scroll container, e.g. "x mandatory".

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.name: size
params.description: Fluid type scale step (S1…S6) — font size that scales with the viewport. On a text element (h1…h6, p) the element TYPE picks the step and this is ignored; use `tag` to change the heading level without changing the size.
params.deprecated: on this component `size()` set width and height, which collided with the `size` option (fluid type scale). Use `dimensions(w, h)`.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). Uses the element's own `scrub` range when it has one. Nothing is split at prerender or under reduced motion. Do not combine with `reveal` by word or line on the same element.

params.name: spy
params.description: Scroll spy: the in-page links inside this element (href="#id") are marked aria-current="true" and styled while their section is the one in view — the section that crosses the reading line, 30% down the view below `offset` (see spy.line). `true`, or {activeStyle: {…css}, offset: px, line: 0.3}. Default style: underline. Links to <body>/<html>, or to an element that contains the link (e.g. `#top` on <body id="top">), are never treated as sections.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: Tab order: 0 puts the element in the natural order, -1 makes it focusable from script only. Positive values reorder the page and are best avoided.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag to render, independent of `size`/`fluid`: a heading level (h1–h6, p) or a text-level tag — blockquote, figcaption, li, dt, dd, cite, time, small, strong, em, span, q, address, label.

params.name: textWrap
params.description: CSS text-wrap, e.g. "balance" for headings or "pretty" for paragraphs.

params.name: title
params.description: Advisory tooltip (the title attribute). Not applied where `title` is already the element's visible label (dropdown, form fields) — a tooltip repeating the label adds noise.

params.name: transform
params.description: A CSS transform string applied verbatim, or an object handled by reactOnTransform(). Composed with `scale` when both are given.

params.name: transition
params.description: CSS transition, verbatim — also what hover/focus/groupHover changes animate with when they give no `animation` timing.

params.name: type
params.description: The element type, which selects the mapper that builds it -- "h1", "cards", "form", and so on.

params.name: vars
params.description: Custom CSS properties on this element — {"--nod-split": 0.2}. Custom properties inherit, so writing them on a root drives its whole subtree with one declaration; that is how the morph axes reach every generated element without a stylesheet.

params.name: width
params.description: CSS width — a length with a unit, e.g. "100%" or "320px". A bare number is not a CSS length and is ignored.

params.name: alt
params.description: Description for an icon that carries meaning; omit for decoration.

params.name: area
params.description: This element's grid-area — the name of a cell declared in the parent's `areas`.

params.name: aria
params.description: ARIA attributes, e.g. {label: "Close", hidden: true, current: "page", live: "polite", describedBy: "note"} → aria-label="Close", aria-hidden="true", … Booleans become "true"/"false", arrays of ids are space-joined, null removes the attribute.

params.name: background
params.description: Background — any CSS colour or background shorthand.

params.name: block
params.description: Render as a block-level element rather than inline.

params.name: bold
params.description: Shorthand for font-weight bold. Overrides `weight` if both are given.

params.name: border
params.description: A plain CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #0B0B0C", on every element. Object forms a component knows ({width, color}, a design node) keep working where they did.

params.name: borderObj
params.description: Border as {width, color, type?, radius?}. Width carries its unit, e.g. "1px".

params.name: bottom
params.description: CSS bottom, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: breakWord
params.description: Allow long words to wrap mid-word (word-wrap: break-word).

params.name: center
params.description: Centres this element's CHILDREN. `true` for both axes, `"x"` horizontal, `"y"` vertical. Axis-aware: in a flex column `"y"` is justify-content, in a row it is align-items; a grid uses justify-items/align-items. To centre the element itself inside its parent, use `mar: "center"`.

params.name: clipPath
params.description: CSS clip-path, e.g. "inset(0 round 12px)" or "circle(50%)". On img a value that is not CSS is read as SVG path data, as before.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: CSS color-scheme, e.g. "light": the scheme the browser draws this element's native parts in (form controls, the option list of a select) and its descendants'. A page that declares `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">` to keep Chrome's auto dark mode off still gets dark controls for visitors in dark mode; colorScheme "light" on its sections keeps them light.

params.name: columns
params.description: CSS columns (multi-column text), e.g. "2" or "18em 3". On gridOverlay `columns` is its own cell count.

params.name: copy
params.description: Copy this text to the clipboard on click, Enter or Space (`true` copies the element's own text). The element becomes a keyboard-operable button and shows `copied` for 1.5 s, announced politely to screen readers.

params.name: count
params.description: Count the first number in the text up when it scrolls into view: `true`, or {from: 0, to, duration: 1200, decimals, locale}. Only the first number moves; the text ends exactly as written and screen readers get the final figure throughout. Reduced motion shows the final text.

params.name: cssFilter
params.description: CSS filter, verbatim — e.g. "blur(4px) saturate(1.2)". Named cssFilter because `filter` on a wrap means frosted glass, and the `filter` design op is a node.

params.name: datetime
params.description: Machine-readable date/time for a `time` element (text `tag: "time"`, wrap `as: "time"`), written to its datetime attribute, e.g. "2026-06-14" or "2026-06-14T09:00". Ignored on any other tag.

params.name: exact
params.description: Font size as an exact CSS length, e.g. "0.875rem".

params.name: fit
params.description: Scale the font so the text fills the element's width on one line; re-fits on resize and when web fonts load.

params.name: flexDirection
params.description: CSS flex-direction ("row", "column", …). On a wrap it is `flexDir` by its CSS name and also sets display:flex.

params.name: focus
params.description: Styles for keyboard focus (focus-visible, on the element or inside it), when they should differ from `hover`. Same shape as hover.

params.name: fontStretch
params.description: CSS font-stretch — a variable font's width, e.g. "125%" for wide letters (the font must load that width range).

params.name: fontVariantNumeric
params.description: CSS font-variant-numeric, e.g. "tabular-nums" for aligned figures.

params.name: fontVariationSettings
params.description: CSS font-variation-settings — set a variable font's axes directly, e.g. "'wdth' 151, 'GRAD' 50".

params.name: gap
params.description: CSS gap, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: gpos
params.description: Grid placement — {col, row}, written to grid-column and grid-row.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover
params.description: Styles this element takes while its nearest `group: true` ancestor is hovered or holds keyboard focus, e.g. {color: "#b83a0b", transform: "translateX(4px)"}. Same shape as hover.

params.name: height
params.description: CSS height — a length with a unit.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: hover
params.description: Styles applied while the pointer is over the element AND while it (or something inside it) has keyboard focus, e.g. {background: "#111", color: "#fff", animation: "0.2s ease"}. Any CSS property in camelCase; `animation` is the transition timing. The original inline styles come back on leave. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: icon
params.description: An image beside the link text: {url, size: "20px", padding: "10px" (the gap between them), side: "end" (after the text) or "start" (before it, as a flag before a language name), alt: ""}. Decorative by default (empty alt, hidden from screen readers) because the link already has a name — its text, or `aria: {label}` for an icon-only link. Give `alt` only when the icon says something the name does not.

params.name: id
params.description: This element's DOM id. Also what a design node's `target` names, and what `parse` recovers an element by.

params.name: keySet
params.description: Escape hatch — {key, value} written straight to element.style, or an array of them.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of this element's content, e.g. "cs" — so a screen reader switches pronunciation for a quote or a name in another language.

params.name: loop
params.description: Animate the element forever, with no stylesheet: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], duration: ms, easing, direction, delay}. Keyframes are CSS properties in camelCase, e.g. [{backgroundPosition: "0px 0"}, {backgroundPosition: "99px 0"}]. Skipped for prefers-reduced-motion and where the browser has no Web Animations (the prerender).

params.name: mar
params.description: Margin. The same array-of-side-objects form as `pad`: `mar: [{a: 40}]`, keys `a t r b l`, combinable. Additionally `mar: "center"` sets left and right to auto, as does `{a: "auto"}` or `{center: true}`.

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: CSS max-height — a length with a unit.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: CSS max-width — a length with a unit.

params.name: minHeight
params.description: CSS min-height, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: minWidth
params.description: CSS min-width, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: onScroll
params.description: Tie a style to the scroll position: {value: "opacity" | "scale" | "trn", from, to (scrollY px), valMin, valMax} — for "trn", valMin/valMax are {tx, ty}. Under prefers-reduced-motion it does nothing: no scroll listener, and the element keeps its own style.

params.name: pad
params.description: Padding. An array of side objects: `pad: [{a: 40}]`. Keys are `a` all, `t` top, `r` right, `b` bottom, `l` left. Keys combine, so `{tb: 12}` sets top and bottom. A bare number is treated as px; any string is passed through, so `{a: "2rem"}` works.

params.name: pin
params.description: Keep the element stuck to the top of the viewport for this much extra scroll, e.g. "80vh". Also {length: "200vh", media: "(min-width: 900px)"} or an ARRAY of those — the first whose media matches wins, and nothing matching means no pin (a sideways track on desktop only, or only with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`) — position: sticky, followed by an empty aria-hidden spacer of that height. Sticks within its PARENT: it stays stuck until the parent ends, so siblings after it scroll past underneath it — pin the last child of a wrap. An ancestor with overflow other than visible, or a stretching flex row, stops it sticking. Applies under reduced motion too (pinning is not motion).

params.description: Prefer this id when the Designer emits code for the element.

Ends at the element's own opacity and position. Elements already scrolled past show at once, and so does what was on screen in the prerendered copy when the live page takes over. Nothing is hidden for reduced-motion visitors or where it cannot run (the prerender). On `img`, `reveal` is the image's own mask reveal instead.

params.name: role
params.description: ARIA role, e.g. "note", "region", "button". Prefer a semantic tag (`as`, `tag`) where one exists.

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). Uses the element's own `scrub` range when it has one. The real text stays in the page for screen readers, selection and innerText; the slices are the letter's own ::before/::after (with empty alt text), not elements. Nothing is split at prerender or under reduced motion. Do not combine with `reveal` by word or line on the same element.

params.name: spy
params.description: Scroll spy: the in-page links inside this element (href="#id") are marked aria-current="true" and styled while their section is the one in view — the section that crosses the reading line, 30% down the view below `offset` (see spy.line). `true`, or {activeStyle: {…css}, offset: px, line: 0.3}. Default style: underline. Links to <body>/<html>, or to an element that contains the link (e.g. `#top` on <body id="top">), are never treated as sections.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: Tab order: 0 puts the element in the natural order, -1 makes it focusable from script only. Positive values reorder the page and are best avoided.

params.name: title
params.description: Accepted as a synonym for `label`, for parity with `labelInput`.

params.name: transition
params.description: CSS transition, verbatim — also what hover/focus/groupHover changes animate with when they give no `animation` timing.

params.name: type
params.description: The element type, which selects the mapper that builds it -- "h1", "cards", "form", and so on.

params.name: aria
params.description: ARIA attributes, e.g. {label: "Close", hidden: true, current: "page", live: "polite", describedBy: "note"} → aria-label="Close", aria-hidden="true", … Booleans become "true"/"false", arrays of ids are space-joined, null removes the attribute.

params.name: background
params.description: Background — any CSS colour or background shorthand.

params.name: copy
params.description: Copy this text to the clipboard on click, Enter or Space (`true` copies the element's own text). The element becomes a keyboard-operable button and shows `copied` for 1.5 s, announced politely to screen readers.

params.name: count
params.description: Count the first number in the text up when it scrolls into view: `true`, or {from: 0, to, duration: 1200, decimals, locale}. Only the first number moves; the text ends exactly as written and screen readers get the final figure throughout. Reduced motion shows the final text.

params.description: Scale the font so the text fills the element's width on one line; re-fits on resize and when web fonts load.

params.name: focus
params.description: Styles for keyboard focus (focus-visible, on the element or inside it), when they should differ from `hover`. Same shape as hover.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover
params.description: Styles this element takes while its nearest `group: true` ancestor is hovered or holds keyboard focus, e.g. {color: "#b83a0b", transform: "translateX(4px)"}. Same shape as hover.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.description: Styles applied while the pointer is over the element AND while it (or something inside it) has keyboard focus, e.g. {background: "#111", color: "#fff", animation: "0.2s ease"}. params.name: lang

params.name: loop
params.description: Animate the element forever, with no stylesheet: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], duration: ms, easing, direction, delay}. Keyframes are CSS properties in camelCase, e.g. [{backgroundPosition: "0px 0"}, {backgroundPosition: "99px 0"}]. params.name: pin

params.description: ARIA attributes, e.g. {label: "Close", hidden: true, current: "page", live: "polite", describedBy: "note"} → aria-label="Close", aria-hidden="true", … Booleans become "true"/"false", arrays of ids are space-joined, null removes the attribute.

params.name: background
params.description: Background — any CSS colour or background shorthand.

params.name: block
params.description: Render as a block-level element rather than inline.

params.name: bold
params.description: Shorthand for font-weight bold. Overrides `weight` if both are given.

params.name: border
params.description: A plain CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #0B0B0C", on every element. Object forms a component knows ({width, color}, a design node) keep working where they did.

params.name: borderObj
params.description: Border as {width, color, type?, radius?}. Width carries its unit, e.g. "1px".

params.name: bottom
params.description: CSS bottom, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: breakWord
params.description: Allow long words to wrap mid-word (word-wrap: break-word).

params.name: center
params.description: Centres this element's CHILDREN. `true` for both axes, `"x"` horizontal, `"y"` vertical. Axis-aware: in a flex column `"y"` is justify-content, in a row it is align-items; a grid uses justify-items/align-items. To centre the element itself inside its parent, use `mar: "center"`.

params.name: clipPath
params.description: CSS clip-path, e.g. "inset(0 round 12px)" or "circle(50%)". On img a value that is not CSS is read as SVG path data, as before.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: CSS color-scheme, e.g. "light": the scheme the browser draws this element's native parts in (form controls, the option list of a select) and its descendants'. A page that declares `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">` to keep Chrome's auto dark mode off still gets dark controls for visitors in dark mode; colorScheme "light" on its sections keeps them light.

params.name: columns
params.description: CSS columns (multi-column text), e.g. "2" or "18em 3". On gridOverlay `columns` is its own cell count.

params.name: copy
params.description: Copy this text to the clipboard on click, Enter or Space (`true` copies the element's own text). The element becomes a keyboard-operable button and shows `copied` for 1.5 s, announced politely to screen readers.

params.name: count
params.description: Count the first number in the text up when it scrolls into view: `true`, or {from: 0, to, duration: 1200, decimals, locale}. Only the first number moves; the text ends exactly as written and screen readers get the final figure throughout. Reduced motion shows the final text.

params.name: cssFilter
params.description: CSS filter, verbatim — e.g. "blur(4px) saturate(1.2)". Named cssFilter because `filter` on a wrap means frosted glass, and the `filter` design op is a node.

params.name: datetime

params.name: exact
params.description: Font size as an exact CSS length, e.g. "0.875rem".

params.name: fit
params.description: Scale the font so the text fills the element's width on one line; re-fits on resize and when web fonts load.

params.name: flexDirection
params.description: CSS flex-direction ("row", "column", …). On a wrap it is `flexDir` by its CSS name and also sets display:flex.

params.name: focus
params.description: Styles for keyboard focus (focus-visible, on the element or inside it), when they should differ from `hover`. Same shape as hover.

params.name: fontStretch
params.description: CSS font-stretch — a variable font's width, e.g. "125%" for wide letters (the font must load that width range).

params.name: fontVariantNumeric
params.description: CSS font-variant-numeric, e.g. "tabular-nums" for aligned figures.

params.name: fontVariationSettings
params.description: CSS font-variation-settings — set a variable font's axes directly, e.g. "'wdth' 151, 'GRAD' 50".

params.name: gap
params.description: CSS gap, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: gpos
params.description: Grid placement — {col, row}, written to grid-column and grid-row.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover
params.description: Styles this element takes while its nearest `group: true` ancestor is hovered or holds keyboard focus, e.g. {color: "#b83a0b", transform: "translateX(4px)"}. Same shape as hover.

params.name: height
params.description: CSS height — a length with a unit.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: hover
params.description: Styles applied while the pointer is over the element AND while it (or something inside it) has keyboard focus, e.g. {background: "#111", color: "#fff", animation: "0.2s ease"}. Any CSS property in camelCase; `animation` is the transition timing. The original inline styles come back on leave. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: icon
params.description: An image beside the link text: {url, size: "20px", padding: "10px" (the gap between them), side: "end" (after the text) or "start" (before it, as a flag before a language name), alt: ""}. Decorative by default (empty alt, hidden from screen readers) because the link already has a name — its text, or `aria: {label}` for an icon-only link. params.name: id
params.description: This element's DOM id. Also what a design node's `target` names, and what `parse` recovers an element by.

params.name: items
params.description: The list entries, each an element spec -- `{ type, ... }` -- or a plain string.

params.name: keySet
params.description: Escape hatch — {key, value} written straight to element.style, or an array of them.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of this element's content, e.g. "cs" — so a screen reader switches pronunciation for a quote or a name in another language.

params.name: loop
params.description: Animate the element forever, with no stylesheet: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], duration: ms, easing, direction, delay}. Keyframes are CSS properties in camelCase, e.g. [{backgroundPosition: "0px 0"}, {backgroundPosition: "99px 0"}]. Skipped for prefers-reduced-motion and where the browser has no Web Animations (the prerender).

params.description: Margin. The same array-of-side-objects form as `pad`: `mar: [{a: 40}]`, keys `a t r b l`, combinable. Additionally `mar: "center"` sets left and right to auto, as does `{a: "auto"}` or `{center: true}`.

params.name: maxWidth

params.name: minHeight

params.name: minWidth

params.name: ordered

params.name: pad
params.description: Padding. An array of side objects: `pad: [{a: 40}]`. Keys are `a` all, `t` top, `r` right, `b` bottom, `l` left. Keys combine, so `{tb: 12}` sets top and bottom. A bare number is treated as px; any string is passed through, so `{a: "2rem"}` works.

params.name: pin
params.description: Keep the element stuck to the top of the viewport for this much extra scroll, e.g. "80vh". Sticks within its PARENT: it stays stuck until the parent ends, so siblings after it scroll past underneath it — pin the last child of a wrap. An ancestor with overflow other than visible, or a stretching flex row, stops it sticking. Applies under reduced motion too (pinning is not motion).

params.name: preffersId
params.description: Prefer this id when the Designer emits code for the element.

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius. A bare number is read as pixels; a string is used verbatim.

params.name: raster
params.description: Attach a WebGL raster pipeline. Array of op nodes; see the Raster section.

params.name: resmar
params.description: Responsive margin — per-breakpoint overrides of `mar`, in the same form.

params.name: respad
params.description: Responsive padding — per-breakpoint overrides of `pad`, in the same form.

params.name: resprop
params.description: Per-breakpoint style overrides — [{breakpoint, ...css}], {min, max, ...css}, {container: {min, max}, ...css}, or {media: "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)", ...css} for any media query (reduced motion, hover, orientation). Precedence: container, then media, then width. `exact` is font size.

params.description: Entrance when the element scrolls into view: {y: 24, x: 0, opacity: 0, scale, duration: 700, delay: 0, easing, stagger: ms, by: "word"|"line", once: true, threshold: 0.15}. `stagger` brings the element's CHILDREN in one after another; `by` (text) brings its words or lines in. Ends at the element's own opacity and position. Elements already scrolled past show at once, and so does what was on screen in the prerendered copy when the live page takes over. Nothing is hidden for reduced-motion visitors or where it cannot run (the prerender). On `img`, `reveal` is the image's own mask reveal instead.

params.name: right
params.description: CSS right, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: role
params.description: ARIA role, e.g. "note", "region", "button". Prefer a semantic tag (`as`, `tag`) where one exists.

params.name: scrollSnapAlign
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-align on a child, e.g. "start" or "center".

params.name: scrollSnapType
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-type on the scroll container, e.g. "x mandatory".

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.deprecated: on this component `size()` set width and height, which collided with the `size` option (fluid type scale). Use `dimensions(w, h)`.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). params.name: reveal
params.description: Entrance when the element scrolls into view: {y: 24, x: 0, opacity: 0, scale, duration: 700, delay: 0, easing, stagger: ms, by: "word"|"line", once: true, threshold: 0.15}. `stagger` brings the element's CHILDREN in one after another; `by` (text) brings its words or lines in. Ends at the element's own opacity and position. Elements already scrolled past show at once, and so does what was on screen in the prerendered copy when the live page takes over. Nothing is hidden for reduced-motion visitors or where it cannot run (the prerender). On `img`, `reveal` is the image's own mask reveal instead.

params.name: right
params.description: CSS right, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: role
params.description: ARIA role, e.g. "note", "region", "button". Prefer a semantic tag (`as`, `tag`) where one exists.

params.name: scrollSnapAlign
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-align on a child, e.g. "start" or "center".

params.name: scrollSnapType
params.description: CSS scroll-snap-type on the scroll container, e.g. "x mandatory".

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). Uses the element's own `scrub` range when it has one. The real text stays in the page for screen readers, selection and innerText; the slices are the letter's own ::before/::after (with empty alt text), not elements. Nothing is split at prerender or under reduced motion. Do not combine with `reveal` by word or line on the same element.

params.name: spy
params.description: Scroll spy: the in-page links inside this element (href="#id") are marked aria-current="true" and styled while their section is the one in view — the section that crosses the reading line, 30% down the view below `offset` (see spy.line). `true`, or {activeStyle: {…css}, offset: px, line: 0.3}. Default style: underline. Links to <body>/<html>, or to an element that contains the link (e.g. `#top` on <body id="top">), are never treated as sections.

params.name: src
params.description: The same as `url` — the name HTML uses.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: Tab order: 0 puts the element in the natural order, -1 makes it focusable from script only. Positive values reorder the page and are best avoided.

params.name: textWrap
params.description: CSS text-wrap, e.g. "balance" for headings or "pretty" for paragraphs.

params.name: title
params.description: Advisory tooltip (the title attribute). Not applied where `title` is already the element's visible label (dropdown, form fields) — a tooltip repeating the label adds noise.

params.name: top
params.description: CSS top, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: transform
params.description: A CSS transform string applied verbatim, or an object handled by reactOnTransform(). Composed with `scale` when both are given.

params.name: transition
params.description: CSS transition, verbatim — also what hover/focus/groupHover changes animate with when they give no `animation` timing.

params.name: type
params.description: The element type, which selects the mapper that builds it -- "h1", "cards", "form", and so on.

params.name: url
params.description: The .glb / .gltf file. Required. `src` is accepted as the same thing.

params.name: vars
params.description: Custom CSS properties on this element — {"--nod-split": 0.2}. Custom properties inherit, so writing them on a root drives its whole subtree with one declaration; that is how the morph axes reach every generated element without a stylesheet.

params.name: width
params.description: CSS width — a length with a unit, e.g. "100%" or "320px". A bare number is not a CSS length and is ignored.

params.name: area
params.description: This element's grid-area — the name of a cell declared in the parent's `areas`.

params.name: aria
params.description: ARIA attributes, e.g. {label: "Close", hidden: true, current: "page", live: "polite", describedBy: "note"} → aria-label="Close", aria-hidden="true", … Booleans become "true"/"false", arrays of ids are space-joined, null removes the attribute.

params.name: background
params.description: Background — any CSS colour or background shorthand.

params.name: bold
params.description: Shorthand for font-weight bold. Overrides `weight` if both are given.

params.name: border
params.description: A plain CSS border shorthand, e.g. "1px solid #0B0B0C", on every element. Object forms a component knows ({width, color}, a design node) keep working where they did.

params.name: borderObj
params.description: Border as {width, color, type?, radius?}. Width carries its unit, e.g. "1px".

params.name: bottom
params.description: CSS bottom, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: children
params.description: The content shown when it is open, as element specs. It stays in the page while closed, so find-in-page and search engines still see it.

params.name: clipPath
params.description: CSS clip-path, e.g. "inset(0 round 12px)" or "circle(50%)". On img a value that is not CSS is read as SVG path data, as before.

params.name: colorScheme
params.description: CSS color-scheme, e.g. "light": the scheme the browser draws this element's native parts in (form controls, the option list of a select) and its descendants'. A page that declares `<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">` to keep Chrome's auto dark mode off still gets dark controls for visitors in dark mode; colorScheme "light" on its sections keeps them light.

params.name: columns
params.description: CSS columns (multi-column text), e.g. "2" or "18em 3". On gridOverlay `columns` is its own cell count.

params.name: copy
params.description: Copy this text to the clipboard on click, Enter or Space (`true` copies the element's own text). The element becomes a keyboard-operable button and shows `copied` for 1.5 s, announced politely to screen readers.

params.name: count
params.description: Count the first number in the text up when it scrolls into view: `true`, or {from: 0, to, duration: 1200, decimals, locale}. Only the first number moves; the text ends exactly as written and screen readers get the final figure throughout. Reduced motion shows the final text.

params.name: cssFilter
params.description: CSS filter, verbatim — e.g. "blur(4px) saturate(1.2)". Named cssFilter because `filter` on a wrap means frosted glass, and the `filter` design op is a node.

params.name: dismiss
params.description: Close it again on a click outside it, on Escape (focus returns to the summary) and when a link inside it is followed — what a dropdown (a language picker, a small menu) needs and a plain <details> does not do.

params.name: exact
params.description: Font size as an exact CSS length, e.g. "0.875rem".

params.name: fit
params.description: Scale the font so the text fills the element's width on one line; re-fits on resize and when web fonts load.

params.name: flexDirection
params.description: CSS flex-direction ("row", "column", …). On a wrap it is `flexDir` by its CSS name and also sets display:flex.

params.name: focus
params.description: Styles for keyboard focus (focus-visible, on the element or inside it), when they should differ from `hover`. Same shape as hover.

params.name: fontStretch
params.description: CSS font-stretch — a variable font's width, e.g. "125%" for wide letters (the font must load that width range).

params.name: fontVariantNumeric
params.description: CSS font-variant-numeric, e.g. "tabular-nums" for aligned figures.

params.name: fontVariationSettings
params.description: CSS font-variation-settings — set a variable font's axes directly, e.g. "'wdth' 151, 'GRAD' 50".

params.name: gap
params.description: CSS gap, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: group
params.description: Make this element a hover group: descendants with `groupHover` change while the group is hovered or holds keyboard focus.

params.name: groupHover
params.description: Styles this element takes while its nearest `group: true` ancestor is hovered or holds keyboard focus, e.g. {color: "#b83a0b", transform: "translateX(4px)"}. Same shape as hover.

params.name: height
params.description: CSS height — a length with a unit.

params.name: hideOnScroll
params.description: Slide this element out of view while the page scrolls down and back as soon as it scrolls up. Only for an element that is (or sits in) a position: fixed or sticky box; never moves under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: hover
params.description: Styles applied while the pointer is over the element AND while it (or something inside it) has keyboard focus, e.g. {background: "#111", color: "#fff", animation: "0.2s ease"}. Any CSS property in camelCase; `animation` is the transition timing. The original inline styles come back on leave. Instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

params.name: id
params.description: This element's DOM id. Also what a design node's `target` names, and what `parse` recovers an element by.

params.name: keySet
params.description: Escape hatch — {key, value} written straight to element.style, or an array of them.

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of this element's content, e.g. "cs" — so a screen reader switches pronunciation for a quote or a name in another language.

params.name: left
params.description: CSS left, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: loop
params.description: Animate the element forever, with no stylesheet: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], duration: ms, easing, direction, delay}. Keyframes are CSS properties in camelCase, e.g. [{backgroundPosition: "0px 0"}, {backgroundPosition: "99px 0"}]. Skipped for prefers-reduced-motion and where the browser has no Web Animations (the prerender).

params.name: mar
params.description: Margin. The same array-of-side-objects form as `pad`: `mar: [{a: 40}]`, keys `a t r b l`, combinable. Additionally `mar: "center"` sets left and right to auto, as does `{a: "auto"}` or `{center: true}`.

params.name: maxHeight
params.description: CSS max-height — a length with a unit.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: CSS max-width — a length with a unit.

params.name: minHeight
params.description: CSS min-height, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: minWidth
params.description: CSS min-width, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: open
params.description: Start expanded. The visitor can still close it; find-in-page opens it on its own when a match is inside.

params.name: pad
params.description: Padding. An array of side objects: `pad: [{a: 40}]`. Keys are `a` all, `t` top, `r` right, `b` bottom, `l` left. Keys combine, so `{tb: 12}` sets top and bottom. A bare number is treated as px; any string is passed through, so `{a: "2rem"}` works.

params.name: pin
params.description: Keep the element stuck to the top of the viewport for this much extra scroll, e.g. "80vh". Also {length: "200vh", media: "(min-width: 900px)"} or an ARRAY of those — the first whose media matches wins, and nothing matching means no pin (a sideways track on desktop only, or only with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`) — position: sticky, followed by an empty aria-hidden spacer of that height. Sticks within its PARENT: it stays stuck until the parent ends, so siblings after it scroll past underneath it — pin the last child of a wrap. An ancestor with overflow other than visible, or a stretching flex row, stops it sticking. Applies under reduced motion too (pinning is not motion).

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius. A bare number is read as pixels; a string is used verbatim.

params.name: resmar
params.description: Responsive margin — per-breakpoint overrides of `mar`, in the same form.

params.name: respad
params.description: Responsive padding — per-breakpoint overrides of `pad`, in the same form.

params.name: resprop
params.description: Per-breakpoint style overrides — [{breakpoint, ...css}], {min, max, ...css}, {container: {min, max}, ...css}, or {media: "(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)", ...css} for any media query (reduced motion, hover, orientation). Precedence: container, then media, then width. `exact` is font size.

params.name: scrub
params.description: Scroll-linked animation: {keyframes: [{…css}, {…css}], from: "enter", to: "exit", easing: "linear"}. The keyframes play as the page scrolls between two points — "enter" (element top at viewport bottom), "full" (fully in view), "top" (top at viewport top), "exit" (bottom at viewport top), "page" (the whole document), "pin" (the `pin` length). Also sets `--progress` (0–1) on the element. An ARRAY of {media: "(min-width: 768px)", …} picks the first whose media matches. Reduced motion shows the last keyframe.

params.name: scrubSource
params.description: What scroll drives `scrub` — "auto" or "window". "auto" (default): the nearest ancestor that actually scrolls vertically, when the element sits in one (a scrolling panel, a modal), else the window. "window": always the page's own scroll. With a scrolling ancestor the range points ("enter", "exit", "page", …) are measured against that box instead of the viewport. Also accepted inside the scrub object or a variant.

params.name: slice
params.description: Letters cut into horizontal slices that slide apart with the scroll: they come together as the text scrolls in, hold whole while it is read, and break apart letter by letter as it scrolls away. `true`, or {slices: 2 (or 3), from: "enter", to: "exit", assemble: 0.3, scatter: 0.72, stagger: 0.6, order: "random"|"start"|"end"|"center", seed, distance: 1.5}. `assemble` is the share of the range spent coming together (0: starts whole), `scatter` where breaking apart begins (1: never). Uses the element's own `scrub` range when it has one. The real text stays in the page for screen readers, selection and innerText; the slices are the letter's own ::before/::after (with empty alt text), not elements. Nothing is split at prerender or under reduced motion. Do not combine with `reveal` by word or line on the same element.

params.name: speed
params.description: Pixels per second. Default 40 — slow enough to read.

params.name: spy
params.description: Scroll spy: the in-page links inside this element (href="#id") are marked aria-current="true" and styled while their section is the one in view — the section that crosses the reading line, 30% down the view below `offset` (see spy.line). `true`, or {activeStyle: {…css}, offset: px, line: 0.3}. Default style: underline. Links to <body>/<html>, or to an element that contains the link (e.g. `#top` on <body id="top">), are never treated as sections.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: Tab order: 0 puts the element in the natural order, -1 makes it focusable from script only. Positive values reorder the page and are best avoided.

params.name: textWrap
params.description: CSS text-wrap, e.g. "balance" for headings or "pretty" for paragraphs.

params.name: title
params.description: Advisory tooltip (the title attribute). Not applied where `title` is already the element's visible label (dropdown, form fields) — a tooltip repeating the label adds noise.

params.name: top
params.description: CSS top, written verbatim. A bare number is read as px.

params.name: transform
params.description: A CSS transform string applied verbatim, or an object handled by reactOnTransform(). Composed with `scale` when both are given.

params.name: transition
params.description: CSS transition, verbatim — also what hover/focus/groupHover changes animate with when they give no `animation` timing.

params.name: type
params.description: The element type, which selects the mapper that builds it -- "h1", "cards", "form", and so on.

params.name: vars
params.description: Custom CSS properties on this element — {"--nod-split": 0.2}. Custom properties inherit, so writing them on a root drives its whole subtree with one declaration; that is how the morph axes reach every generated element without a stylesheet.

params.name: width
params.description: CSS width — a length with a unit, e.g. "100%" or "320px". A bare number is not a CSS length and is ignored.
